title: My House
description: Practise there is/are and have got, and write a short description of your home.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: There ___ two bedrooms in my house.
exercises.explanation: Use "there are" with plural nouns: there are two bedrooms.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with have or has.
answers: have
exercises.explanation: Use "have got" with I, you, we and they: we have got.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: There is a table in the kitchen.
In the kitchen there is a table.
Is there a table in the kitchen?
exercises.explanation: There is + a singular noun + place: There is a table in the kitchen.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: There are a sofa in the living room.
answers: There is a sofa in the living room.
There's a sofa in the living room.
exercises.explanation: Use "there is" (there's) with one thing: there is a sofa.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: This is ___ bedroom. I love it!
exercises.explanation: Use "my" before a noun to show that something belongs to you: my bedroom.

exercises.prompt: Write the word in brackets with 's.
answers: sister's
exercises.explanation: Add 's to a person to show that something belongs to them: my sister's room.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" for a surface: on the sofa, on the table.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
answers: We have got two bathrooms.
exercises.explanation: After a number bigger than one, add -s to the noun: two bathrooms.

exercises.prompt: Write a or an.
exercises.text: There is ___ armchair in my bedroom.
answers: an
exercises.explanation: Use "an" before a vowel sound: an armchair.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: My dog plays in the garden.
In the garden my dog plays.
exercises.explanation: Use "in" for the garden: in the garden.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.explanation: Use "has got" with it (our flat = it): our flat has got.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
answers: The kitchen is very big.
The kitchens are very big.
exercises.explanation: Use "is" with one thing (the kitchen) and "are" with more than one.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: My room is small, ___ it is very nice.
exercises.explanation: Use "but" to join two different or opposite ideas.

exercises.prompt: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets.
exercises.text: My dad ___ (cook) in the kitchen every evening.
answers: cooks
exercises.explanation: With he, she and it, add -s to the verb: my dad cooks.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I like reading in my bedroom.
In my bedroom I like reading.
exercises.explanation: Like + verb-ing: I like reading.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: The lamp is in the table.
answers: The lamp is on the table.
The lamp is under the table.
The lamp is next to the table.
The lamp is near the table.
The lamp is by the table.
exercises.explanation: Use "on" for a surface: the lamp is on the table. We are not "in" a table.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct word.
exercises.text: ___ there any windows in the bathroom?
exercises.explanation: Make questions with "Are there" + a plural noun: Are there any windows?

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Me house is near the park.
answers: My house is near the park.
exercises.explanation: Use "my" (not "me") before a noun: my house.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: I can see the sea from my window.
From my window I can see the sea.
Can I see the sea from my window?
exercises.explanation: Subject + can + verb: I can see the sea.

exercises.prompt: Write in, on or at.
exercises.text: We have dinner in the kitchen ___ seven o'clock.
answers: at
exercises.explanation: Use "at" with clock times: at seven o'clock.

task.prompt: Write about your house or flat.
contentPoints: Say where your home is and if it is big or small.
Say what your favourite room is and why.
task.modelAnswer: I live in a small house in the city. There are three bedrooms, a kitchen and a living room. We have got a little garden with flowers. My favourite room is my bedroom because it is blue and quiet. I read and play games there.
